name: diffusers-quantization-benchmarks
description: Benchmarks the impact of various quantization strategies on diffusion-based generative models (Diffusers). It measures both generated image quality and system-level performance (inference speed, memory usage) after quantization, allowing comparison of fidelity vs. efficiency trade-offs. Typical evaluations report perceptual/image-quality metrics alongside runtime and memory metrics.
evaluation_method: Image-quality and system metrics (e.g. FID, CLIP score, LPIPS) together with runtime/throughput and memory usage
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset used by researchers and engineers experimenting with quantization of diffusion models; modest but growing adoption.
